title: Adding Another Item with is: X és Y is itt van

sections.content: You can combine és ('and') with is ('also/too') to ask about two things at once: naming both with és, then using is right before the verb to say both share the same property.

items.spanish: A múzeum és a mozi is itt van?
items.english: Are the museum and the cinema here too?

items.spanish: A park és a kórház is messze van.
items.english: The park and the hospital are both far.

sections.content: Even with two subjects joined by és, is still comes only once, right before the shared verb -- not after each noun separately.
